# Awesome Linux dotfiles 🧙‍♂✨

![screenshot](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/46892933/632828793-1af81b90-6143-46cf-ad4d-12a6c55671f4.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..rrkFEtKg06v5aErj_i8APljqXM1pkWm_0oSxU2jCqBI)

| **Window manager**       | **[hyprland](https://github.com/hyprwm/Hyprland), [sway](https://github.com/swaywm/sway)** |
|:-------------------------|:-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| **Status bar**           | **[waybar](https://github.com/Alexays/Waybar)**                                            |
| **Application launcher** | **[rofi](https://github.com/davatorium/rofi)**                                          |
| **Notification daemon**  | **[dunst](https://github.com/dunst-project/dunst)**                                        |
| **Terminal**             | **[alacritty](https://github.com/alacritty/alacritty)**                                    |
| **File manager**         | **[yazi](https://github.com/sxyazi/yazi)**                                                 |
| **Editor**               | **[neovim](https://github.com/neovim/neovim)**                                             |
| **Terminal multiplexer** | **[zellij](https://github.com/zellij-org/zellij)**                                         |
| **Shell**                | **[fish](https://github.com/fish-shell/fish-shell)**                                       |

```bash
# Deploy configuration files and plugins (fish, yazi) to $HOME via GNU Stow
./bootstrap.sh install

# Show all available commands
./bootstrap.sh --help
```
